qualification.details: Desired Experience: Thorough experience in (a) environmental microbiology, including enrichment and isolation of selective bacteria from environment; (b) Biochemical, molecular and genomic characterization of bacteria; and (c) microbiological - analytical techniques, including DNA/RNA based techniques, amplicon, metagenomics, etc.

salary_details.research associate (ra): Upto 65000 per month (fixed at one of the 3 pay levels depending upon qualification and experience)

how_to_apply: Visit the online application portal provided by IIT Kharagpur Sponsored Research and Industrial Consultancy.
Deposit the required application fee (if applicable) through RTGS, NEFT, or net banking using the provided institute bank account details.
Note down the transaction details including the UTR number or transaction ID.
Fill out the online application form completely and provide the transaction details.
Submit the application form online on or before 22 October 2026.

content_sections.text: Desired Experience: Thorough experience in (a) environmental microbiology, including enrichment and isolation of selective bacteria from environment; (b) Biochemical, molecular and genomic characterization of bacteria; and (c) microbiological - analytical techniques, including DNA/RNA based techniques, amplicon, metagenomics, etc.

rows.qualification_required: Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or having 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment about?
faq.answer: IIT Kharagpur has invited online applications for 1 temporary Research Associate (RA) post under the Department of Bioscience and Biotechnology for the project titled "Microbial solutions for sustainable and regenerative agriculture: improvement of nitrogen and phosphorous flux".

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Research Associate (RA) position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 22 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D./MD/MS/MDS or equivalent degree or have 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the last date of the advertisement, with relaxations as per sponsor agency rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The application fee is 0 for all categories including General, OBC, SC, ST, and Female candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the consolidated compensation offered?
faq.answer: The monthly consolidated compensation is upto 65000, fixed at one of the 3 pay levels depending upon qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the project assignment?
faq.answer: The tenure is for 12 months or until the termination of the project, whichever is earlier.
